answer: Proof-of-Foraging Ledger. Each agent must submit a trail of verified sensor readings from prior tasks; a new identity inherits none, so it must wander real environments to collect fresh evidence before acting. The scarce resource is embodied history, not money. A unique nectar sampling record from a physical site anchors each identity to time and place. An attacker pays by running real hardware through real sites for weeks per fake agent, which scales linearly and cannot be bought.
